name: Weighing and Loading on to Boat
summary: This painting is from an album depicting the silk industry. In the 19th century in China families in rural areas often produced silk. They then sold their yarns or fabrics to silk merchants. This painting shows the various activities going on in the silk-producing areas. You can see the silk product
